checks.name: Token management requires a password session, same origin, valid names and expiry
Browser creates a named token, reveals it once, and stores only its digest
Concurrent creation keeps both tokens and token credentials cannot access other admin capabilities
Tokens are restricted to their own jobs and incomplete/corrupt multipart uploads cannot publish
Actual upload CLI resumes multipart state with only MIRROR_API_TOKEN and publishes independently verified bytes
UI navigation stays separate, layouts fit mobile, and revocation immediately blocks further upload requests
Concurrent revocation/creation preserves unrelated tokens; expired credentials are rejected
Sign-out and admin-key reset invalidate credentials while a new generation works
